notes.title: Update #15 - The Flying Dutchman
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/pocjeZI.png[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3oGRFDf5ECafTAtNFm/giphy.gif[/img]
Legend tells of a sky ship crewed by the damned souls of haunted sky pirates, captained by it’s merciless crab leader. With the arrival of Grimlock, the Flying Dutchman has docked off the shores of Kingsfall. Battle across 4 new Versus maps on the tiny platforms of the Dutchman and challenge yourself with 3 new quests atop the ghost ship. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/X35d4pe.png[/img]
SkyBall matches are now played within a set time limit. If by the end of the time limit both teams have a tied score, the game will go into a sudden death overtime, where the first team to score wins!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/rlYynb5.png[/img]
Ball Hog, Pacifist, MVP, and Alley-Oop. Play to find out how to earn them!

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]New single player quests.
[*]Balances trophy tiers on all quests.
[*]Frostguard and the Gryphon powerup is now locked by default and must be unlocked.
[*]Increase movement speed for the Gryphon and Airship.
[*]New swamplands versus map.
[*]Feline Frenzy now involves killing a Jade bot with 9 lives.
[*]Timer on quests will not start until all bots have finished spawning.
[*]Added Esc key as an option for pausing the game when using Keyboard.
[*]Removed jump SFX.
[*]Disconnecting or reconnecting a gamepad on the main menu will now return you to character [*]selection.
[*]Lightning effects will no longer flash if Disable Flashing setting is turned on.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug with Gryphon Practice Stage showing skulls instead of gryphon eggs.
[*]Fixed bug with unlock alerts not fading in properly.
[*]Fixed bug with same skins unlocking repeatedly if the game isn’t reloaded.
[*]Fixed Press Start Button ribbon showing wrong controller type.
[*]Fixed skin selection treasure chest showing wrong controller type.
[*]Fixed dunked skyballs scoring two points instead of one.
[*]Fixed pausing with the keyboard when a gamepad is plugged in pausing for the wrong player.
[*]Fixed “GO” text in quests overlapping the pause menu.
[*]Fixed player corpses spawning with the wrong animation state.
[*]Fixed bug with players getting trapped beneath an airship. This will now kill the player.
[*]Fixed controller disconnect and reconnect not working.
[*]Fixed cancelling stream settings menu breaking the Main Menu.
[/list]

I'm super excited to bring you guys this new stage! I hope you enjoy and let me know what you think!

-Qazi 
P.S. the Flying Dutchman must be unlocked through Quest Mode.

notes.title: Update #14 - Quest Mode and Hammer Fin
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/aC7vSZB.png[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3osxYhlXo1ka3I9vNe/giphy.gif[/img]

New to the skies? Prepare for battle with Quest Mode, where you take on challenges like target practice, battle against AI, or run from the rising lava. Already a pro? See if you can earn a Diamond trophy with insane speed runs.
The first version of Quest Mode included 12 challenges to test your grappling hook skills.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Arm6MOK.png[/img]
The first major Hero Skin is out today, Hammer Fin, a totally new skin option for Fin. You’ll have to unlock this adorable little guy in Quest Mode!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/0ghKBAi.png[/img]
All the Pink hero skins are now locked by default and need to be unlocked in Quest Mode.

[h1]Twitch Integration Menu[/h1]
The twitch integration has been updates to allow you to connect your bot to Skyhook so that it can chat to your viewers about what is going on. You can also set how long you want countdowns to be and how long chat messages should be delayed.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]SkyBall now uses Time in minutes to end the match. Timer displays on screen during the match, and when it ends the team with a higher score wins.
[*]Player holding the SkyBall can now double jump.
[*]Updated Twitch integration to include new AWS servers and old servers.
[*]HUD elements like player hearts fade out when a player goes behind them.
[*]Increased loading time to launch game.
[*]CPU players will auto select their teams when going to the Team menu.
[*]Black Hero skins have been removed so that they can be redone.
[*]Camera blur effect for menus.
[*]Toggling fullscreen will now switch the game’s resolution to 720p.
[*]Player hearts now disappear during the Mirror powerup.
[*]Inverse black colored skins have been removed while I make them more awesome.
[/list]

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug with SkyBall and Swag steal stat not working.
[*]Fixed bug with triggers not working.
[*]Fixed bug with wallslide sfx playing even when a player isn’t moving.
[/list]

Thank you so much for all your bug reports, feedback and support guys! Looking forward to seeing your highscores on Steam! Don't forget to post screenshots over at http://steamcommunity.com/app/361350/screenshots/

P.S. all these updates were made live during my twitch streams! Weekdays at 2pm EST at http://twitch.tv/qazitv Come say hi!

notes.title: Update #11 - Sky Ball Season!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/AV8upMa.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/hFP0Cry.gif[/img]
Hold onto your grappling hooks ladies and gentlemen, because it’s officially Sky Ball season! Sky Ball is the most popular sport in the world of Skyhook, where two teams battle it out to throw the ball into the other team’s goal. There are no fouls or red cards in this sport, hook the other team to their death, grab the sky ball, and swing towards the goal.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Xe8x91s.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/QQ0OTW5.gif[/img]
With the introduction of Sky Ball, I wanted to take the time to make it so that you could play team matches in any of the game modes. Team Deathmatch is no longer one of the options, instead you can play Deathmatch, Steam Tank and Sky Slayers as a team! On top of that, the new team selection menu allows you to choose teams for bots too! There are no more limitations on what modes you can and cannot play with bots.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[*]Increased player movement speed.
[*]All character now have the same movement speed.
[*]Decreased respawn time by 1 second.
[*]Gryphons will no longer disappear when a player jumps or dodges off of them. They will stay on screen until their timer runs out.
[*]New 2d shadow system for players, items, and mounts.
[*]AI will not go for powerups it already has.
[*]Improved flight path navigation for bots on mounts.
[*]Decreased bot’s ability to dodge and increased their chance to attack players.
[*]Overall improvements to AI players.
[*]Added hover effect to player tokens.
[*]Climbing up and down through platforms will kill during Deadly Dodge mutator.
[*]New death sounds and voice overs on character deaths.
[*]New FX when a player is killed by a hook.
[*]New Magma Cove stage music!
[*]Added more platforms to Magma Cove II.
[*]Mask power ups have been removed from the game.
[*]Darkened character selection rooms to know when a player hasn’t selected.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[*]Fixed bug with bots not able to traverse platforms near lava.
[*]Fixed bug with bots standing still during Swag matches.
[*]Fixed bug where Airship hover animations would break if the game is paused.
[*]Fixed bug with outlines on Steam Tank ammo not displaying properly.
[*]Fixed bug where players earned Swag points even after the match ended.
[*]Fixed bugs with character selection when a gamepad is disconnected or reconnected.
[*]Fixed bug where bots would not fire once on a ship or turret.
[*]Fixed bug where variants could not be selection with custom controls Keyboard.

I’m super excited to bring you guys these new updates, and am anxious to hear what you think about Sky Ball! As always please feel free to leave comments here, head over to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/361350/discussions/]Steam Discussion boards[/url], or tweet me [url=https://twitter.com/WaseQazi]@waseqazi![/url]

See you in the skies!
-Qazi

notes.content:

notes.title: Update #5 - Winds of Change
notes.content:
Today we're introducing one of the biggest changes to the game thus far. The characters are no longer exactly the same!

Each character now has a different type of dodge move. In addition to that, all characters have the ability to perform a parry, which deflects hooks, by dodging downwards while standing. With these changes and more to come, we hope to add some more depth and challenge to Skyhook, while keeping its accessibility.

This is a big change for us, so we'd love to hear what you think!

You can always reach out to us here on Steam or privately at dev@megastormgames.com

[h1]Dodging[/h1]
[list]
[*]Anara disappears and reappears at the end of her dodge, making her unpredictable and scary as hell to fight.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/y6zJ9a6.gif[/img]
[*]Fin can control his direction while dodging on the ground and cancel his dodge. Be careful though, his air dodge is not nearly as powerful.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Smh9CoJ.gif[/img]
[*]Runa has the most balanced dodge, it resembles the original dodge mechanic the most.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/v6YxdM6.gif[/img]
[*]Jade has the fastest dodge, and quickly changes directions onces its over.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/sZxQNAj.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Parrying[/h1]
[list]
[*]Parry enemy hooks by doding downwards while standing, sending their hook flying back to them.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/tcG7kSx.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Other Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Random option in character selection.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Explosions are now a lot bigger and a bit more dynamic.
[*]Powerups and chest now light up.
[*]Increased fast fall speed.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug with ghosts not interacting with hooks properly.
[*]Fixed bug with dead bodies getting stuck on edges
[/list]

notes.title: Update #2 - Did Somebody Say Fish?
notes.content:
Update #2 is now live! This build brings a lot of balance changes, gameplay tweaks, and visual aesthetics. Feedback from the community has been a huge part of these improvements, so thank you and I looking forward to hearing more!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]First version of Trophies for each player at the end of every match.
[*]New World Map with Random option and variation selector.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/2cP8KaK.png[/img]
[*]New background music for the Swamplands (formerly Anuran Shrines)
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Player will automatically climb up through a platform when holding in the up direction or pressing the dash or jump button, while swinging into the bottom of a platform.
[*]Added telegraphs to where sudden death bombs will fall to.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/XeK1GLD.gif[/img]
[*]Sudden death will no longer spawn in the Tombs of Ra.
[*]Changed player’s arm during wall sliding to show their sheathed Skyhook.
[*]Added some acceleration for when hooks return to you.
[*]Starting spawn point assignment for each player is randomized at the start of each match
[*]When the Doppelganger powerup is in effect, all players will stay transformed even after dying until the timer for the powerup ends.
[*]Added a ghost trail effect to when players dodge to better track enemy movement.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/1q66YGY.gif[/img]
[*]Rumble effects added for winning games and opening chests
[*]Game will automatically pause when it is minimized or loses focus during a match.
[*]Background ambient sounds will now stop playing after match ends.
[*]Background music will be lower when game is paused.
[*]Compressed some background music audio files
[*]Updated Jade’s pirate flag to look more like a cat.
[*]Added sound effects to pause menu
[*]Reset save files for game options to prepare for Steam Cloud integration.
[*]Removed tips and added short loading screens featuring character art.
[/list]

[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adjusted dodge animations so that it is clear when a player is hit after their dodge ends.
[*]Removed Mirror powerup from spawning during 1 on 1 matches.
[*]Increased wall jump height to match normal jump height
[*]Adjust spawn points in Swamplands II
[/list]

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed issues with XInput not working on Windows.
[*]Fixed Rematch button after match ends not always working.
[*]Fixed counting killing yourself with your own cannonball as a kill stat.
[*]Fixed sudden death bombs being counted as a kill stat for other players.
[*]Fixed clouds so that they always spawn relative to the camera’s current position.
[*]Normalized input during Match Settings to prevent too many inputs at once.
[*]Fixed alignment of player’s arm with rope when wall sliding.
[*]Fixed hooks not raycasting properly when returning to owner.
[*]Fixed bug where hook would sometimes detach from platform if player was falling fast
[*]Fixed bug where Doppelganger powerup decal would disappear too early.
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who has purchased the game so far! If you have any bugs or feedback feel free to post them on our Bug Discussion Board [url]http://steamcommunity.com/app/361350/discussions/0/598198356182253466/[/url]
